description: Search Google and get parsed results as JSON: organic_results (position, title, link, domain, displayed_link, snippet, date), related_searches, search_information (including spelling corrections) and pagination. 10 results per page; position restarts at 1 on every page. Every search runs from one fixed location (location, lat and lon, or uule; otherwise the capital of the gl country), so repeats and later pages stay consistent. pages fetches up to 5 consecutive pages in one call as one de-duplicated list. Priced per results page returned (see https://webscraping.ai/docs#serp); failed searches are not charged. Use it to find pages, then read them with webscraping_ai_text or the other tools.

disable_content_sandboxing.description: Return the raw result without the external-content security boundaries that guard against prompt injection (false by default).

engine.description: Search engine to query (google by default).

gl.description: Two-letter country code for the search, e.g. us, gb, de. Defaults to the country of location, lat/lon or uule, otherwise us.

hl.description: Two-letter language code for the results, e.g. en, de, fr (en by default).

lat.description: Latitude of the search origin in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90. Requires lon; cannot be combined with location or uule.

location.description: Where the search runs from: a location name such as Austin,Texas,United States or Austin, TX, or an id from webscraping_ai_serp_locations. Large cities also match local names, e.g. Москва. An unknown name returns an error and is not charged. Cannot be combined with uule, lat or lon.

lon.description: Longitude of the search origin in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180. Requires lat; cannot be combined with location or uule.

page.description: Results page number, 10 results per page (1 by default).

pages.description: Number of consecutive results pages to fetch in one call, starting at page, from 1 to 5 (1 by default). Duplicates across pages are removed, position counts through the combined list and each result gets a page field.

radius.description: Radius in meters around location or lat/lon, from 1 to 1000.

uule.description: Google-encoded location (w+CAIQICI… or a+…). Cannot be combined with location, lat or lon.

name: webscraping_ai_serp
title: Search Google
